lesson.subtitle: Lesson 5 -- Hotel Check-In
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 5 -- Hotel Check-In

listenings.text: Hello, this is Sam at the front desk. Welcome to your room. The elevator is on the left. Our gym is on the first floor, and it is open from six in the morning. Do you need a towel or a pillow? Call the front desk: number nine. Have a nice evening.
Hi, Bruna, it is Emma. Your taxi for tomorrow is at nine. It is in front of the hotel. Please leave your key at the front desk. And the gym is open early, at six. Have a good night!

extra_audio.text: Bruna arrives at the Park Hotel. Sam gives her the key to room 412. She asks: where is the elevator? She asks for the Wi-Fi password. She asks for one more towel.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: Can I have a towel, please?
lesson.grammar_point: Can I have...? for polite requests + this / that
